test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

You have the power ______ the perspective of this nation.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**to change**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, "You have the power" is the main clause.
 
• The phrase following "power" should be in the infinitive form (base form) of the verb because it indicates what action can be taken with that power.
 
• "**To change**" is the infinitive form of the verb "**change**," and it's the appropriate choice because it indicates what action can be done with the power.
 
• So, the complete sentence reads: "*You have the power to change the perspective of this nation.*"
 
• This means that you have the ability to influence or modify the way the nation views or perceives something.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentenc**e: *You have the power to change__ the perspective of this nation.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Changing**" is a present participle and does not fit grammatically.
 
• "**Change**" is in the base form and would require an auxiliary verb such as "can" or "will" to make sense in the sentence.
 
• "**Changed**" is in the past tense and does not fit the present tense sentence.
